newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 14.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average tumbled 148.36 points or 2.3 percent to 6391.69 on inflation and interest rate concerns.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index fell 9.60 points or 0.84 percent to 1,138.36 on Friday. Hopes for a rebound this week may have been squashed by the Dow's drop, analysts said.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5036/46 a dollar at around 0930 GMT on Friday, after rangebound trading.

* Stock market continues to digest impact of Bank Negara's curbs on property and stocks lending. While viewed as positive for the long-term in preventing speculation, analysts say impact for near-term may slow growth and profits.
* Banks due to report back to central bank on April 15 on how they intend to comply with the new regulations.
* After steady declines, 1,100 support on Composite Index being eyed for possible break.
* Muhammad Muhammad Taib quits at weekend as chief minister of Selangor. Muhammad, a vice president of UMNO, is on trial for allegedly failing to declare nearly $1 million while leaving Australia.
